title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
edition: Wikimedia Commons, File:Mary Had a Little Lamb.pdf, uploaded by Ferbr1 on 2012-03-13; one-page MuseScore 1.0 engraving.
editionAuthor: Typesetter not independently identified; Ferbr1 is the uploader, not asserted as composer or engraver.
method: Visually read the rendered PDF and record each bar independently of the trainer. Compare named historical settings before accepting a composer attribution.
rights: The edition file/footer and Commons listing declare PD (old) / public domain in the USA. Used for note verification; no source engraving or lyrics included in the web release.
attributionLimit: PDF prints Lowell Mason and Sarah Josepha Hale. This is not adopted as verified authorship of this particular tune. The read 1831 Mary's Lamb setting and 1911 Moffat setting begin with repeated pitches, unlike this descending step opening. No claim about the first publication or composer of the familiar tune is made.
changes: transpose melody down 7 semitones from G major to C major
assign piano right hand and explicit project digits 1–5
choose 64 BPM; source has no numeric tempo
no lyrics or historical composer claim

contrastSources.title: Mary's Lamb, Juvenile Lyre, 1831, p.61
contrastSources.verified: Read the opening repeated-pitch setting, not the descending-step melody of the project. Do not transfer composer credit from a shared title.
